rows.assessment: Xu et al. 2021, PMID:33897634, PMCID:PMC8058359, scientific Abstract; direct JATS match and native VERIFIED. Own JZD02 experiment, Methods and actual Figure 1 A-C support infection of Meloidogyne incognita eggs. Supplementary Table 1 defines infection by hyphal penetration through an individual egg, not mere surface contact. Its 30-hour printed mean disagrees with the replicate counts; no numerical infection rates are adopted. The 6-hour control and 42-hour infected transcriptomes differ in time and include mixed infection stages. Expression associations are not causal protein evidence.

native_probe.limits: Infection evidence, not direct nutrient flux or a causal protein mechanism.

rows.assessment: Xie et al. 2016, PMID:27486440, PMCID:PMC4949223, Figure 5 caption, panel B; actual panels A-C and Methods/Results inspected. P. lilacinum denotes Purpureocillium lilacinum. Direct JATS match; native NOT_IN_ABSTRACT is retained. This is its own 36-1 infection experiment, not a repetition of Xu's citation. Eggs were supplied as the only nourishment for the reported 24-hour comparison, but microscopy does not quantify nutrient assimilation. RNA-seq replicates were pooled; gene homology and expression do not demonstrate a required effector.

novelty.interpretation: The recognized egg-parasitic infection strategy requires fungal eggshell penetration and internal colonization, not merely a context suffix on generic feeding. Existing fungal nematophagy requires food consumption but includes previously dead prey; hatching inhibition/stimulation, killing, paralysis, attraction and trapping have different endpoints. No same-scope synonym, ungrounded graph node or parent-gap discussion was identified in matched maintained trait owners.

hierarchy: METPO:1004002 is active below pathogenic-to-host METPO:1004000, phenotype METPO:1000059 and quality METPO:1000188. Pinned animal-pathogen wording is organism-like, but its phenotype hierarchy and current upstream explicitly phenotype-based definition agree on this host-pathogenic disposition. The source calls the fungus egg-pathogenic and documents infection of a nematode developmental stage; this does not entail mammalian pathogenicity. Fungal nematophagy is related but food consumption is not a required measured endpoint in the operational infection definition. Local parasitism inherits persistent symbiosis, which is not asserted here. No organism-level disjointness is claimed.
historical_identity: METPO:1000227 obsolete parasitism is a broader historical lead, deprecated true, under ObsoleteClass, reason OMO:0001000, with no replacement or consider annotation in pinned/current releases. No exact counterpart in inspected releases, editor or template owners; ontology pin is unchanged.

source_assessment.xu2021: Own JZD02 infection experiment and actual Figure 1 A-C support egg infection. Supplementary Table 1 explicitly defines infection by penetration through the whole individual egg. Its 30-hour mean is inconsistent with replicates; numerical rates are not curated. Time-separated 6-hour and 42-hour transcriptomes mix infection and time/stage effects; no expression-to-causality claim.
source_assessment.xie2016: Own 36-1 experiment, distinct strain/lab from Xu, with microscopy-confirmed infection and actual Figure 5 A-C inspected. The revised six-word caption identifies the fungus and replaces the earlier anaphoric probe. Eggs were supplied as the only nourishment, but no direct nutrient-assimilation measurement is asserted. Pooled RNA-seq replicates and gene conservation/expression do not prove causal protein mechanisms.
